mentions.name: EPUB cleanup and fix tool
mentions.description: This tool cleans up and fixes EPUB files that have transcription errors, incomplete or inaccurate metadata, and other issues. Users can accept, reject, or edit proposed fixes as they review each file. A command-line interface and TUI (built with Ratatui) are working, while a Calibre plugin and a WASM-based web version are still in development.
mentions.problem: EPUB files often contain transcription errors and incomplete or inaccurate metadata.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a side project to clean up and fix EPUB files with transcription errors, incomplete or inaccurate metadata, and other issues.
mentions.author: techwizrd
